    NetworkConnectionFactory - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network
    Concrete ConnectionFactory that establishes the client's connection to the server over either RMI or sockets, returning in both cases a ServerAdapter the client can talk through.
    NetworkConnectionFactory() - Constructor for class it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.NetworkConnectionFactory
     
    NetworkSetupController - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.controllers
    First TUI screen: it asks the user for the connection settings (RMI or socket, server IP and port), opens the connection through the factory and wraps it in a ConnectionManager for automatic reconnection, then registers it on the context.
    NetworkSetupController(TUIContext) - Constructor for class it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.controllers.NetworkSetupController
    Creates the network-setup screen bound to the shared context.
